# Crypto Dispatch
Crypto news and market-structure analysis for builders and developers.

## Coverage
Liquidity, execution, MEV, stablecoin settlement, derivatives, and protocol incentives.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/): Latest coverage and analysis.
- [About](https://dailynewscrypto.github.io/about/): Editorial approach, independence, sourcing, and corrections.
